about:
# Death Messages
Shows a random message of your choosing at random when you die.
Press the cogwheel in the bottom left corner to open the mod settings. From there, press the folder icon to find the phrases.txt file. Edit it to add or remove phrases.

changelog:
# 1.3.0
- Added a button in the settings that allows you to disable messages in practice. (created by memr404)
# 1.2.0
- If a message ends with \\#, it will now have only have a chance to appear at a certain percentage. Any number that is higher than 100, lower than 0, or contains anything except a whole number can be shown at any time.
- The message from the previous death will now disappear immediately if it is still on screen when the next death occurs.
# 1.1.0
- Added support for Geode v5 / GD 2.2081.
# 1.0.1
- Added repository URL. (I always forget it)
# 1.0.0
- Initial release. Expect bugs.
